what: Land polygons for the maps on /instruments: Natural Earth 1:50m land, fetched from the Natural Earth vector repository pinned by commit. The atlas draws a copy with coordinates rounded to 0.01° (tools derive it at build; this file is the source). Added 2026-10-06: Natural Earth 1:10m land and minor islands, for the Janela app's Brazilian margin (apps/janela derives a clipped copy at build).
